description.text: The sixth expansion of the XY series, released on 14 March 2015, with Mega Rayquaza on the wrapper. After the land and sea of Gaia Volcano and Tidal Storm, its theme is the sky, with many flying Pokémon among its Colorless types. M Rayquaza-EX's Ancient Trait, Δ Evolution, lets it evolve from a Rayquaza-EX put into play that same turn, and its attack Emerald Break does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon, up to 240. M Latios-EX, M Gallade-EX, Shaymin-EX and Hydreigon-EX join it, with Double Dragon Energy and Sky Field, a Stadium that lets each player have up to eight Benched Pokémon. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 78, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX, Winona and Wally, and Ultra Rare gold Energy Switch and VS Seeker. In English most of its cards came out in Roaring Skies in May 2015.
